keyFindings.mechanism: conservative eager-catalog removal with single scope-stub replacement
keyFindings.reason: Stripping belongs to a system-prompt-owning extension; adopt the zero-catalog-data stub discipline as a brief-format invariant.

keyFindings.mechanism: constant-size scope stub (label + count + fixed instructions)
keyFindings.reason: A one-line indexed-candidate count is the cheapest transferable unit of the lazy-catalog design.
The advisor cannot safely remove prompt content it does not own.
The recurring-cost levers exist (dedup, policy skip, cache); they need measurement and wider use.

keyFindings.mechanism: scope-stub + on-demand search replacing the eager catalog
keyFindings.reason: Feasible only on system-prompt-owning surfaces (Pi first); elsewhere the stub discipline lives in the brief.
Advisor policy-skip + exact-prompt cache + dedup already dominate; only the O(n) catalog term is a real gap.

keyFindings.mechanism: model-pulled recovery surface named in the fail-open envelope
keyFindings.reason: Name the existing advisor_recommend pull handle in the fail-open fallback so timeout turns self-heal.
Adopt the pull shape but back it with the advisor scorer, not substring ranking.
Pull-only trades a reported transport failure for silent non-discovery.

keyFindings.mechanism: preferred search scope with bounded global fallback
keyFindings.reason: Soft family preference with the global pool always open; hard scoping would turn ranking misses into silent blocks.
Nothing to gate at brief time; only replace-on-change state hygiene transfers.
A one-line empty-scope report removes the did-the-advisor-run misreading at negligible cost.
Bundle loading belongs to the runtime loading layer; the brief picks the single best root.
Borrow detection heuristics into reviewed edge maintenance so graph-causal weights track reality.
Surface graph health on the advisor_status trust surface, not in model context.
A literal skill-name mention is the highest-intent prompt class and deserves a short-circuit pin.
Advisor lanes strictly subsume it; importing would subtract capability.
Already present in fusion; recorded as a tuning invariant protecting the dedup cache.
Proven output shape, directly reusable for the advisor pull surface.
The token cap counts the head only; count the constant directive so the bound is honest.
Keep sanitized prefixes of ranking signal fields instead of dropping over-length values to null.
Already embodied as the renderer's fail-closed label sanitizer.
Append-atomic and fail-safe-delegated stores are property-equivalent here.
Briefs must not recommend skills the runtime refuses to self-invoke; read the flag into the projection.
Static contract guards catch Pi refactors before runtime dispatch does.
